claim_hygiene: Public synthetic / known-answer fixtures only. The default and headline vs_rho workload is exactly one previously unseen target, solved by both arms on the identical public point. Online time starts at the first target-dependent computation after reusable IC setup is ready, excludes launch, loading, and fixture construction, and ends after independently verified recovery. Never substitute a multi-target average, batch throughput, or shared-table amortization for this result. Multi-target work is secondary and requires a separate declared question after the one-target measurement. Never combine best component costs from different runs into a synthetic vs_rho win.
historical_note: Earlier specialized runners (kic_autolab, beats_rho_autolab, direct_n37_autolab) left only __pycache__ bytecode under sibling autolab_* dirs. This control plane replaces them for boundary-ledger work and drives the still-present Rust producers.
